source_text: Tres citra Iordanen, tres ultra — ubique refugium. Ecclesia in omni terra asyla aperit.
pass_a_gloss: Three on-this-side Jordan, three beyond — everywhere refuge. Church in every land asylums opens.
pass_b_english: Three west of Jordan, three east — refuge everywhere. The church opens asylums in every land.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Joshua homilies; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105
